linux_setup_title: Linux Flashing & SP Flash Tool Setup
linux_setup_welcome: Met anplas SP Flash Tool pou Linux

linux_card_engine_title: Moter ki pe flash (SP Flash Tool)
linux_card_engine_desc: Zouti flashing natif MediaTek avek konpatibilite bibliotek iniversel ki finn staz.
linux_card_usb_desc: Donn permision desktop pou kominik avek zwer-la dan mod Bootloader.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Tool System Checker & Diagnostics
system_checker_desc: Verifikasion konpreansif bann drayver, bann modil kernel, bann permision, ek bann bibliotek runtime pou asir enn flashing fiab.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Prepar ou ordinater pou konekte ar ou zwer pou bann miz-a-zour lozisiel.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Verifie konfigirasion avanse Linux pou SP Flash Tool, akse USB, permision serial, ek bann konpozan sistem.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Prepar ou ordinater pou konekte ar ou zwer e instal bann miz-a-zour lozisiel dan enn fason fiab.
settings_checker_desc: Prepar ou ordinater pou konekte ar ou zwer e instal bann miz-a-zour lozisiel dan enn fason fiab.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Ou ordinater inn pare pou konekte ar ou zwer.
linux_prep_ready: Pare, SP Flash Tool finn pare.
linux_prep_connected_friendly: Zwer finn trouve, pe rafresi akse koneksion...
linux_prep_not_connected_friendly: Ou kapav konekte ou zwer kan demann ou.
linux_prep_blocked: Sa ordinater-la pa pe kapav fer SP Flash Tool marse.
linux_prep_fix_body: Ou modpas bizin enn fwa pou met anplas sa ordinater-la pou flash: bann regleman USB pou bann laparey MediaTek ek akse a bann port serial.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Pou konfigir sa ordinater-la pou SP Flash Tool, ou pou bizin ou modpas dan prosin letap pou konfigir bann reg USB ek azout ou kont dan bann group itilizater seriel neseser. Si ou refize, aplikasion-la pou ferme.
linux_prep_needs_access: Pa finn donn akse, flashing bizin li.
linux_prep_fixed: Akse finn done, SP Flash Tool finn pare.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Konfigirasion finn konplete e ou kont finn azoute dan bann group itilizater neseser pou SP Flash Tool. Re-demar ou ordinater silvouple pou ki bann nouvo permision pran lefe, apre ouver aplikasion-la ankor enn fwa. Klik lor mark-la pou ferm aplikasion-la aster-la mem.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Finn fini, ferm aplikasion pou relans ordinater
settings_driver_desc: Avan servi app-la pou premie fwa, ou bizin instal driver USB MediaTek, apre relans ou ordinater.
system_checker_autofix_btn: Koriz otomatik bann permision ek sistem konfigirasion
home_desc: Rod enn mikrolozisiel an-lign ouswa swazir enn pake lokal, apre flash li lor ou laparey.
home_step_2: Swazir enn lozisiel ek telesarz li
sel_source_desc: Telesarz enn mikrolozisiel an-lign, ouswa inport enn pake lokal.
settings_advanced_desc: Montre metod instalasion, mod instalasion ek bann filtr liberasion.
settings_guided_install: Gid mwa dan instalasion dan app-la
settings_guided_install_desc: App-la res avek ou kan ou tenn li, konekte li, ek instal li.
settings_sp_gui_install: Instal dan SP Flash Tool GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Ferm Updater CE ek ouver SP Flash Tool GUI avek fisie scatter firmware ki finn swazir ek bann zimaz partision ki finn fini sarze.
settings_terminal_desc: Fer ou instalasion lozisiel marse dan Terminal pou ki ou kapav trouv bann linformasion teknik lor progre.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Fer ou instalasion lozisiel marse dan Command Prompt pou ki ou kapav trouv bann linformasion teknik lor progre.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Opsionel. Sertin sib MediaTek refiz flash ziska ki SP Flash Tool gagn enn fisie otantifikasion (.auth); azout pou ou isi si laparey-la bizin enn.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Pa finn trouv okenn fisie dispersion dan sa pake-la, alor pa finn kapav konstrir okenn komann konsol.
terminal_install_no_tool: Pena okenn SP Flash Tool build ou MTKClient entry point disponib pou sa metod-la.
terminal_install_failed: Pa finn kapav ouver enn lafnet terminal. Komann instalasion finn ekrir lor {path}.
status_terminal_install: Komann instal finn ouver dan ou lafnet terminal ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} pou ouver asterla an fonksion {method}.

• Si li pankor tegn, tenn ou {device}.
• Si li konekte ar USB, dekonekte li avan.
{hint}
• Konekte ou laparey ar ou ordinater kan lafnet {terminal_name} finn ouver.

Klik lor OK pou lans ek sorti depi Updater CE.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Konsey: Si laparey-la pa konekte otomatikman, pez dousman bouton reset dan trou-la avek enn trombone pandan ki ou pe konekte kab USB-la.
terminal_hint_generic: • Konsey: Met ou laparey dan mod telesarz mikrolozisiel (li varye dapre model: ex. tir batri-la ek gard li andeor avek enn kab USB konekte, ouswa tenn li avek batri-la, ouswa gard Volim anba/anler pandan ki ou pe konekte USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Instale atraver SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI pou asterla ouver avek ou firmware pre-load.

• Dan SP Flash Tool, swazir "Download" dan bwat deroulan.
• Klik lor bouton "Telesarz".
• Fer sir ki ou {device} finn tenn ek dekonekte.
{hint}
• Konekte kab USB-la ar ou ordinater apre ki ou finn klik lor Telesarze.

Klik lor OK pou lans SP Flash Tool ek sorti depi Updater CE.
settings_install_themes_desc: Kan finn aktive, bann tem Rockbox pou otomatikman transfer dan Y1 apre enn instalasion Rockbox avek sikse.
themes_placement_failed_note: Nou pa finn kapav plas pake tem-la lor ou zwer. Ou kapav sey ankor depi Paramet.
settings_rockbox_desc: Finn aplike kan pe navig bann version lozisiel.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Montre bann version lozisiel orizinal ki pli vie ki 3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Bann version lozisiel orizinal ki pli vie ki 3.0.7 pa konpatib avek bann inite Y1 ki vande avek Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Si ou flash enn vie konstriksion lor sa bann inite-la, sa pou anpes zot demar ziska ki enn nouvo version re-instale.

Eski ou sir ou anvi montre bann version Lozisiel Orizinal ki pli vie ki 3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Montre bann konstriksion ki zot ROM zip enn varyant 240p (rom..._240p.zip). Bann konstriksion 240p pa konpatib avek bann inite Y1 lor Innioasis OS anba 3.0.7, alor Show Old Rockbox Builds finn aktive avek li.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Bann version Rockbox-Y1 avan 0.5 pa konpatib avek bann inite Y1 ki finn vande apre Mars 2026 avek Innioasis OS 3.0.7 pre-instale.

Si ou flash enn vie konstriksion lor sa bann laparey-la, sa pou anpes li demare.

Eski ou sir ou anvi montre bann vie konstriksion Rockbox?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Silvouple swazir enn arsiv .zip, .rar, ou enn fisie scatter (*scatter*.txt) dan enn dosye firmware pou instal firmware ki ou finn swazir lor ou {target}.
sel_offline: Bann lalis an-lign pa disponib aster-la. Servi enn fisie lokal, ouswa verifie ou koneksion.
sel_no_release: Pena version disponib pou sa lozisiel-la
release_notes_loading: Pe gagn bann not pou sorti...
translating_notes: Pe tradir bann not pou sorti...
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Finn trouv plizier package firmware ouswa bann fisie scatter dan sa dosye/arsiv-la. Silvouple swazir enn dosie ouswa enn arsiv ki ena zis enn pake mikrolozisiel alafwa.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Sa version-la kontenir plis ki enn fisie scatter, alor Updater pa kapav dir ki layout ou zwer bizin. Devloper {software} pou bizin met azour so bann version firmware pou inklir zis enn sel fisie scatter.
sp_search_restart: Pena laparey ankor, pe rod ankor (tantativ {count}). Gard zwer-la etenn e konekte li kan bizin.
sp_auth_missing_file: Fisie otantifikasion pa finn trouve ({path}); pe flashe san li.
sp_config_missing_platform: Fisie scatter-la pa deklar so platform, alor konfigirasion konsol pou fisie otantifikasion-la pa finn kapav konstrir; pe flashe san li.
sp_config_missing_storage: Fisie scatter-la pa deklar enn tip stokaz (EMMC/NAND/UFS), alor konfigirasion konsol pou fisie otantifikasion-la pa finn kapav konstrir; pe flashe san li.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Pa finn donn okenn fisie otantifikasion; pe flashe san enn.
sp_config_write_failed: Pa finn kapav ekrir fisie konfigirasion konsol-la; pe flashe san fisie otantifikasion-la.
settings_notifications_desc: Montre bann notifikasyon sistem pou bann tip notis ek miz-a-zour anba. Off gard tou seki ena andan app-la.
settings_notifications_background_btn: Aktiv bann notifikasyon kan aplikasion-la ferme
settings_add_device_type_hint: Tip se revizion materyel zwer-la. Bann zwer mem model kapav konstrir dan plis ki enn revizion — par exanp Tip A ek Tip B — ek lozisiel finn fer pou enn ladan. Verifie stiker ki ena lor ledo zwer-la; si li pa nom enn tip, les premie swa.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Pena okenn version disponib pou sa lozisiel-la aster-la.
settings_notifications_unavailable: Bann notifikasyon sistem pa disponib lor sa ordinater-la.
settings_run_in_background_group: Fer an aryer-plan pou bann notifikasyon
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Gard app-la dan bar meni apre ki lafnet-la ferme, pou ki ou ankor gagn bann notifikasyon azourisman firmware app ek zwer. Dezaktive: ferm lafnet-la kit app-la.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Gard aplikasion-la dan plato sistem apre ki lafnet-la ferme, pou ki ou ankor gagn bann notifikasyon azourisman mikrolozisiel aplikasion ek zwer. Dezaktive: ferm lafnet-la kit app-la.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Kasyet katalog kominote online e instal lozisiel zis depi bann fisie lokal.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Ou finn flash enn konstriksion Rockbox 360p. Eski ou ti pou kontan instal 360p Theme Pack lor sa laparey-la aster-la mem?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Konekte Lekter dan Mod Stokaz USB
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Silvouple dekonekte USB, alim ek demar dan Rockbox enn fwa (pou ki li inisializ so dosie sistem .rockbox intern), apre rekonekte USB ek swazir 'Mod Stokaz USB'.

Kan ou konekte, klik lor Kontign pou swazir ninport ki dosie lor ou lekter.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Seleksionn ninport ki dosye lor stokaz ou zwer konekte
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack finn instale avek sikse lor ou laparey!
sel_only_local: Swazir enn pake firmware lokal .zip ou .rar, ou enn dosye / scatter .txt, pou instalasion offline, pa bizin internet. Mars avek tou lekter odio Innioasis ek Timmkoo.
sel_only_local_generic: Swazir enn pake firmware lokal (.zip, .rar) ou enn dosye ki kontenir enn fisie scatter pou instalasion offline, mars avek bann laparey MediaTek zenerik.
sel_offline_install: Instal enn firmware depi enn fisie .zip ou .rar lor ninport ki lekter odio Innioasis ou Timmkoo.
sel_offline_install_generic: Instal enn firmware depi enn arsiv .zip/.rar ou enn dosye firmware lor bann laparey MediaTek zenerik.
sel_update_available: Ena enn miz-a-zour pou {software} disponib pou ou {model}.
conn_offline: Ou pa an-lign. Bann instalasion depi arsiv mikrolozisiel kominoter pa disponib.
single_instance_body: Enn lot kopi ouver, ou ankor pe roule dan aryer-plan. De kopi pou fer konpetision pou koneksion USB zwer-la, alor sa enn-la pa pou demare.
single_instance_focus_failed: Kopi ki pe roule pa finn reponn demann pou montre so lafnet. Li kapav okipe ouswa anpandan. Fors li aret li pou interonp ninport ki zafer ki li pe instale.
single_instance_force_failed: Kopi ki pe roule pa finn kapav termine. Aret li oumem, apre rekoumans met-a-zour.
single_instance_busy_body: Kopi ki pe roule pe instal lozisiel-la ouswa pe koz avek zwer-la, alor si fini li aster-la, sa pou interonp sa. Sa lansman-la pou ferme; servi lafnet ki deza existe ou so ikon bar meni kan instalasion-la fini.
notices_banner_tooltip: Klik pou get tou bann notis
notices_summary_body: Ouver bann notis dan app-la pou lir zot.
toast_battery_charged: Avan servi sa lor ou zwer, sarz batri-la pou omwin enn-er-tan
toast_battery_charged_device: Avan servi sa lor ou laparey, sarz batri-la pou omwin enn-erd-tan
sel_notes_hint: Seleksionn enn version pou get so zournal sanzman
flash_wait_desc: Tenn laparey-la avan. Si li konekte me pa finn detekte, sey enn lot kab USB ouswa enn lot port.

• Tenn net ou laparey avan koumanse.

• Klik lor Kontign, apre konekte ou laparey par USB kan pou invite.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Tenn net ou laparey MediaTek.

• Klik lor Kontign, apre konekte kab USB kan pou invite.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Nou pa kapav gard ou bann done pou sa instalasion-la parski ou firmware aktyel pa konpatib avek Keep Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Dekonekte kab USB-la ek servi enn trombonn ouswa enn pin pou pez bouton reset, apre esey konekte ankor.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Li rekomande pou konekte zwer-la ar enn sarz miray pandan 30 minit ziska enn-erd-tan avan sey konekte.

flash_keep_data_tooltip: Gard ou bann konfigirasion ek media lor zwe-la. Leres lozisiel-la finn instale kouma dabitid.
flash_keep_data_warning: Si ou kontinie san sa, ou bann paramet ek media pou reset lor stokaz intern zwer-la.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Si ou kontinie san sa, ou bann tem, font ek konfigirasion Rockbox pou retire. Ou lamizik ek lezot media pou res lor zwe-la.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Si ou kontinie san sa, ou bann tem, font ek konfigirasion Rockbox pou retire, ek stokaz intern zwer-la pou reset.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Si ou kontinie san sa, ou bann paramet pou reset. Ou lamizik ek lezot media pou res lor zwe-la.

format_all_data_warning_other: Sa mikrolozisiel-la bizin reformat stokaz intern zwer-la. Bann konfigirasion ek media ki finn anrezistre e ki finn stoke lor stokaz inkorpore pou efase. Media lor ou microSD res anplas.
format_all_confirm_body:
Pou {software} nou bizin reformat stokaz intern ou {model} avan nou kapav kontinie. Lerla pou sey enn lot tantativ SP Flash Tool, me dan mod Format Tou + Telesarz atraver exzekision mod konsol XML.

{data_effect}

err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool finn raporte ki latab partision zwer-la finn sanze (8502). Sa firmware-la bizin instale dan mod Format All + Download, ki reformat stokaz intern.

install_first_needs_answer: Sa firmware-la bizin enn chek firmware debaz, ki bizin enn terminal interaktif.

flash_connect_prompt_mtk: Silvouple fer sir ki ou {model} konekte par USB - apre pez Next.
flash_connect_paperclip_prompt: Konsey: Tenn laparey-la kan ou pez bouton ki kasiet akote priz pou kask avek enn trombonn ouswa enn pin.

settings_run_as_admin_restart_needed: Miz-a-zour CE bizin relanse pou ki bann instalasion fonksionn avek sa bann drwa-la.
settings_run_as_admin_unavailable: Sa desktop-la pena okenn elevation helper disponib.
flash_preparing: Pe prepar pake mikrolozisiel... Gard laparey-la debranse pou lemoman.

support_story_1_headline: Kan bann fabrikan avanse, kominote-la avanse.
support_story_1_lead: Protez ou laparey kont bann piez hardware silansie ek bann revizion kase.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis regilierman lans bann nouvo firmware pou bann zwer kouma Y1 (ki vize bann revizion tablo kasiet kouma 6.0, 7.0, ek 8.0) ki kas bann vie laparey an silans. Pli pir, zot sitweb pa donn okenn avertisman ek okenn akse a bann firmware ki ti pe fonksione avan pou rekipere depi enn leta bloke. Updater CE ek proze Community Firmware ramas bann pies: nou arsiv sak ROM stok leritaz, verifie otomatikman ou revizion hardware, ek gard ou player an fonksionnman an sekirite.
support_story_1_item_1: Sov bann zwer ki finn kase: Bann verifikasion sekirite fer sir ki bann nouvo miz-a-zour zame brik bann vie materyo.
support_story_1_item_2: Bann ROM Stock arsiv: Koleksion konple bann firmware orizinal lizinn Innioasis finn efase.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Bann zouti flashing konple pou macOS, Linux, ek Windows parey.
support_story_1_item_4: Intelizans Materyel: Deteksion otomatik lor tablo pou ki ou touletan gagn bon pake.
support_story_2_headline: Pena Google Drives ki finn kase. Pena travay devine. Zis enn mikrolozisiel ki pe marse.
support_story_2_lead: Infrastriktir kominoter vit ek verifie ki ou kapav vremem depann lor la.
support_story_2_body: Tras bann lozisiel ofisiel Innioasis normalman vedir rod bann forom pou bann lien Google Drive ki finn expire, bann partaz Baidu cloud mor, ek bann fisie zip misterye san okenn zouti flashing. Nou finn konstrir enn rezo telesarzman serye ek indepandan avek lentegrite SHA-256 verifie, bann notifikasyon azourisman, ek bann instalasion gide etap-par-etap. Ou bann donasion gard direkteman bann telesarzman ek hosting ki rann sa posib 24 er par zour, 365 zour par an.
support_story_2_item_1: CDN direk a gran vites: Bann telesarzman rapid ek direk san okenn limit pou telesarz ou bann lien mor.
support_story_2_item_2: Miz-a-zour bann Notifikasyon: Gagn enn alert depi ki bann nouvo version kominoter ouswa bann koreksion sorti.
support_story_2_item_3: Bann Instalasion Etap-par-Etap Gide: Bann instriksion viziel kler gid ou sak fwa ki ou pez bouton.
support_story_2_item_4: Kominote Miltileng: Konpletman lokalize an Angle, Sinwa, Alman, Espanyol, Franse & Zapone.
support_story_3_headline: Deblok tou potansiel ou zwer Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Amenn Rockbox, bann sistem operasion leze personalize, ek liberte bann odiofil.
support_story_3_body: Lozisiel lizinn stok zis grat sirfas seki ou hardware Y1 ou Y2 kapav fer. Nou kominote finn amenn Rockbox, bann sistem operasion personalize leze, leze kodek odiofil, ek bann tem personalize a lavi. Nou aste bann varyasion hardware fizik depi nou pos pou teste, inzenier inverse, ek verifie sak instalasion. Siport Updater CE finans direkteman sa bann inite tes-la e akseler devlopman mikrolozisiel personalize.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Lektir odiofil ek bann tem personalize instale dan de-trwa segonn.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware Kominoter: Ameliorasion batri, UI pli prop, ek soutien modern pou bann codec odio.
support_story_3_item_3: Laboratwar Materyel Aktif: Nou fer bann tes lor bann laparey fizik reel avan ki nou lans ninport ki konstriksion.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% gratwi, lozisiel ki pran kont konfidansialite san okenn piblisite ouswa swivi.
support_story_4_headline: Ed nou fer seki Innioasis pa fer.
support_story_4_lead: Prezervasion mikrolozisiel kominoter ki gard ou bann laparey andeor bann depotwar.
support_story_4_body: Kan enn konpagni hardware al ver so prosin gadjet, bann vie model abandone. Innioasis pa fourni okenn sipor Linux, okenn changelog transparan, ek okenn fason fasil pou rekipere kan enn instalasion fel. Updater CE existe parski bann itilizater pasione pa bizin zet enn lekter lamizik parfetman bon. 100% kontribision kominoter al direk pou gard sa zouti-la ouver pou tou dimounn.
support_story_4_item_1: Sovtaz & Debrik: Rekiperasion finn prouve ki ena mem kan bann laparey refiz demar.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux Premier-Class Support: MediaTek flashing konpletman soutenir lor bann distro Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Bann rezis sanzman transparan: Bann not detaye pou ki ou kone exakteman ki bann sanzman.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Finanse par Kominote: Sak kafe gard arsiv-la ouver ek gratwi pou tou dimounn.

flash_watch_waiting_hint: Gard li konekte, Rockbox pe demare e so bann tem pou azoute otomatikman.
flash_watch_found: Finn detekte zwer, pe azout bann tem Rockbox...
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Verifie ki li branse ek alime. Si li res nwar, pez enn pin dan trou reset e tini bouton santral (Y1) ou bouton alimantasion (lezot zwer) pou relans li. Si li ankor pa pou demare, firmware-la pa finn pran, instal enn lot.
action_brom_detected: Finn detekte laparey dan mod BROM...
action_flash_complete: Flash konple! Dekonekte USB ek re-demar.
task_writing_recovery: Pe ekrir enn lozisiel pou rekiperasyon
action_recover_powercycle: Power-cycle zwer-la (gard pouvwar ~10s), apre rekonekte li - pe re-esey...
action_wait_mtk: Pe atann laparey MTK... Tenn laparey ek konekte USB.
action_da_stall: Laparey finn aret reponn pandan ki ti pe konfigir azan telesarzman. Tenn li net, rekonekte, ek re-esey.
action_detected_brom: Finn detekte laparey (mod BROM) - pe konfigir azan telesarzman...
action_detected_preloader: Finn detekte laparey (mod preloader) - pe konfigir azan telesarzman...
action_da_wait_back: Zwer-la finn aret reponn letan li ti pe demar azan telesarzman. Pe atann li revini...
action_device_connected: Laparey konekte - pe prepar bann komann pou ekrir...
action_formatting: Pe format bann done itilizater ek cache...
log_install_writing: Instalasion an Progre - pe ekrir bann zimaz mikrolozisiel...
log_sparse_fmt: Finn detekte enn zimaz rar Android pou {part}, pe konverti an prosesis...
err_code_connection_failed: Pa finn kapav konekte ar laparey-la
err_code_sp_not_found: SP Flash Tool pa finn trouve
err_code_no_scatter: Pena okenn fisie dispersion dan pake-la
err_code_missing_images: Bann zimaz mikrolozisiel ki manke dan pake-la
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Verifikasion latab partision finn fel apre ki finn ekrir
err_sp_wrong_model: Ou finn konekte enn move model zwer. Klik lor bouton × pou anile sa instalasion-la, apre swazir lozisiel pou zwer ki ou finn konekte.
err_sp_timeout: Sa zouti-la zame finn trouv zwer-la. Gard li tenn ek debranse, apre konekte kab USB-la kan bizin.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Zwer-la finn alime tro boner. Tenn li net, apre konekte li ankor.
err_sp_download_fail: Lekritir finn interonpe. Verifie kab ek port USB ek sarz batri, apre esey ankor.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Azan telesarz-la pa finn kapav demare. Sey lot metod flash.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Azan telesarz-la pa finn kapav avoy zwer-la. Tenn li ek rekonekte li.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Zwer-la finn rezet azan telesarzman (erreur 6104). Servi Download Agent ki ansam avek SP Flash Tool, ek verifie ki firmware-la koresponn ar sa zwer-la.
err_sp_com_port: Zouti-la pa finn kapav ouver so port seriel. Ferm bann lezot zouti ki pe flashe e rekonekte.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Port USB COM pa finn kapav ouver (erreur 1013). Re-demar ou ordinater pou liber port ki finn bloke. Re-demar ou ordinater silvouple e esey ankor.
err_sp_enable_dram: Zouti-la pa finn kapav demar memwar zwer-la. Servi pake ki finn konstrir pou sa model-la exakteman.
err_sp_storage_read: Zouti-la pa finn kapav lir stokaz zwer-la. Verifie koneksion-la; laparey-la kapav ena enn defo dan hardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Zouti ki pe flashe-la pa finn montre okenn progre dan lespas {seconds} segonn, alor sa tantativ-la finn arete.
err_connection_failed_desc: Pa finn kapav etablir enn koneksion stab avek zwer-la. Fer sir ki laparey-la tengn (servi enn pin pou pez bouton reset si bizin), debrans USB, ek rekonekte kan bizin.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Flashing finn interonpe ouswa loperasion ekrir finn fel. Verifie ki kab USB-la bien branse e ki batri-la ena ase sarz, apre sey ankor.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Sa zouti flash-la finn montre mem lalinn pandan bann dernie {seconds} segonn e li pa paret pe kontinie ekrir mikrolozisiel-la. Flash-la kapav finn defonse. Si sa ti dernie dan de tantativ avek sak metod lor enn sistem ki kapav tom ant zot, ou si zis MTKClient ki disponib lor sa masinn-la, re-demar ordinater-la ek esey ankor.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Zis MTKClient ki disponib pou sa instalasion-la. Flash-la kapav finn defonse. Silvouple re-demar ordinater-la ek esey ankor.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Sa ordinater-la kapav osi instale avek SP Flash Tool. Si ou kapav, sanz pou SP Flash Tool ek sey ankor.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Flash-la kapav finn defonse. Silvouple lir mesaz lao ek relans ordinater-la avan esey ankor. Si ou klik lor OK, app-la pou arete pou ki ou kapav relanse.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Sa pake mikrolozisiel-la mank fisie dispersion ouswa bann fisie zimaz neseser. Silvouple re-telesarz pake-la ouswa swazir enn fisie mikrolozisiel konple.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Fisie otantifikasion ki ou finn swazir manke, vid ou pa finn kapav ekrir li. Swazir enn fisie ki valid, ouswa efas li dan Paramet, apre flash ankor.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Pa finn kapav inisializ zouti flashing ou bann driver sistem neseser. Silvouple verifie bann permision sistem, konfigirasion sofer, ouswa re-instal aplikasion-la.
err_driver_missing_desc: Sa erer-la kapav arive kan driver USB MediaTek pa instale. Klik lor Download Drivers pou instal MediaTek USB driver, relans ou ordinater, ek esey ankor.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Enn fisie mikrolozisiel ki finn cache manke. Swazir Seleksionn Lozisiel pou rekonstrir bann fisie ki finn extraire ou telesarz arsiv mikrolozisiel-la ankor enn fwa. Sa se enn problem fisie lokal, pa enn problem koneksion USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Retourn lor Seleksionn Lozisiel pou rekonstrir ouswa telesarz pake mikrolozisiel-la.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Seleksionn enn version mikrolozisiel pou telesarze ankor.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Enn erer inatandi finn arive pandan instalasion ({detail}). Tenn lekter-la net, rekonekte kan bizin, e esey ankor.
flash_method_confirm: Metod instalasion finn sanze pou vinn {method}. Konfirme ki zwer-la finn debranse ek finn tenn, apre klik lor Prosin.
flash_failover_note: {method} pa finn fer instalasion-la koumanse. Apre ki zwer-la finn tenn ek finn debranse, {other} pou servi dan so plas.
themepack_card_desc: Inklir bann zoli tem kominoter, bann toile de fond ot-rezolision, ek bann font ki finn fabrike spesifikman pou bann afixasion 360p.
themepack_installed_success: 360p Theme Pack finn instale avek sikse!
themepack_step1_title: Letap 1: Konekte dan Mod Stokaz USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Alim ou zwe kan ou tini bouton Alimantasion.
2. Kan Rockbox demare, brans kab USB-la dan ou ordinater.
3. Si li invite lor lekran lekter, konfirm mod stokaz USB pou ki laparey-la aparet kouma enn lekipman.
themepack_step2_title: Letap 2: Seleksionn ninport ki dosye lor zwer-la
themepack_step2_desc: Parski bann sistem operasion (kouma macOS) kasiet bann dotfile (kouma .rockbox) par defo, ou kapav swazir NENPORT ki dosye ou rasin lekipman lor ou zwer. Nou pou otomatikman trouv ou kree repertwar .rockbox pou ou.
themepack_complete: Pack tem finn instale avek sikse! Asterla ou kapav dekonekte ou zwer san okenn danze e swazir enn tem dan Rockbox (Paramet > Paramet Tem).
themepack_err_not_found: Pa finn kapav lokaliz ou inisializ enn repertwar .rockbox lor lekipman ki finn swazir. Silvouple fer sir ki ou finn swazir enn dosie lor ou zwer.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Dekonekte kab USB-la.
2. Re-alim zwer-la ek les li demar dan Rockbox.
3. Enn fwa ki Rockbox pe fonksione, rekonekte kab USB-la, apre pez Kontinie.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Letap 2: Pe rod zwer lor ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App-la pe vey enn koneksion ADB (ziska 30 segonn). Si trouv enn laparey, bann tem transfere e lekter-la re-demar otomatikman. Sinon, al dan Mod Stokaz USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Pe atann enn laparey ADB... (ziska 30 segonn)
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Laparey finn trouve ({serial}); pe transfer bann tem...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Okenn laparey ADB pa finn detekte dan 30 segonn; kontinie avek Mod Stokaz USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Okenn biner ADB pa disponib pou app-la; kontinie avek Mod Stokaz USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Pe pous bann tem ek bann font lor ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Transfer ADB finn fel; retourn dan Mod Stokaz USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Aktiv Mod Stokaz USB lor zwe-la pou ki li paret kouma enn lekipman.
2. Swazir NENPORT ki dosye lor lekter anba (.rockbox, Lamizik, Tem, ou rasin lekipman, enn dosye .rockbox kasiet pou lokalize otomatikman).
3. Sa aplikasion-la zwenn bann tem ek bann font 360p, e li re-ekrir bann fisie ki ena mem nom.
rockbox_wizard_done_title: Bann tem ek font 360p finn instale!
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Asterla ou kapav dekonekte zwer-la an sekirite e swazir enn tem dan Rockbox (Paramet > Paramet Tem).
rockbox_stage_installing: Pe instal bann tem ek font Rockbox...
rockbox_cleanup_step: Pe retir bann vie konfigirasion Rockbox...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Ou nouvo lozisiel finn instale, me pa finn kapav retir vie dosye .rockbox. Efas dosie .rockbox lor zwer-la par lame si ou anvi enn bon koumansman.
rockbox_stage_waiting_adb_fmt: Pe rod enn zwer atraver ADB ({remaining}s)...
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Plis ki enn zwer konekte. Dekonekte bann lezot-la ek les zis seki pe instale.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Finn detekte zwer. Pe plas bann tem ek font kominoter...
rockbox_stage_pushing_files_fmt: Pe plas bann fisie tem ({curr} depi {total})...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Tenir bouton santral pou alim ou Y1, rekonekte USB, ek swazir Mod Stokaz USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Tenir bouton alimantasion pou alim ou lekter, rekonekte USB, ek swazir Mod Stokaz USB.
rockbox_recover_troubleshoot: Laparey pa pe demare? Remet lozisiel orizinal-la
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Silvouple dekonekte ek alim ou {model}, apre pez Prosin
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Dekonekte USB, tini {button} pou alim ou {model}, apre pez Next.
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Aktiv mod stokaz USB lor ou laparey silvouple e klik lor Prosin
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Silvouple, aktiv mod stokaz USB lor ou {model}, apre swazir lekipman ki aparet
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Silvouple swazir zwer-la limem ouswa enn bann dosye ki ena lor la
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Dekonekte USB-la ek alim ou Y1, apre pez Next.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Dekonekte USB-la ek alim ou {model}, apre pez Next.
rockbox_ask_running_fmt: Eski Rockbox pe fonksionn lor ou {model}?
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Seleksionn 'Mod stokaz USB' lor ou lekter.
2. Klik 'Browse Folder...' pou swazir ou lekter ek instal bann tem.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Sa konstriksion Rockbox-la servi bann tem 240×320, ki pa ansam. Gagn bann tem gratwi pou ou zwer depi sit tem Rockbox:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Si ou {model} pa demar, dekonekte USB, tini bouton alimantasion pou 10 segonn pou reset, ek alime. Ou restor lozisiel orizinal.
err_storage_full_desc: Ou ordinater finn mank lespas stokaz. Silvouple liber lespas lor disk lor ou lekipman e sey ankor.
err_usb_lost_subtitle: Eski ou ti pou kontan sey ankor?
legacy_cleanup_desc: Enn vie version Updater ankor lor sa ordinater-la e li pran lespas lor disk. Dezinstal li liber sa lespas-la.
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Retir bann vie aplikasion Innioasis Updater ek bann dosye soutien
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Gard Android Platform Tools (ADB / Fastboot) instale
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Si ou pa servi ADB ou Fastboot andeor Updater CE, demarke pou dezinstal ek reklam stokaz adisyonel.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Finn reysi netway instalasion leritaz e finn rekiper lespas lor disk.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Enn vie version Updater ankor lor sa ordinater-la. Dezinstal li pou liber lespas lor disk.
legacy_cleanup_none_found: Pa finn trouv okenn vie version.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Sa retir net vie aplikasion-la, mikrolozisiel ki finn telesarze, ek bann fisie ki reste.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Retir bann Zouti Platform Android (ADB / Fastboot) osi? Swazir Garde si ou servi ADB.
log_btn_goto_file_tip: Revel fisie rezis dan Finder / Explorer
log_btn_save_file_tip: Export fisie zournal ki finn afise lor disk
log_btn_copy_tip: Kopie zournal ki finn afise lor clipboard
